name: Decline
description: Columns falling away down the sheet, each one shorter than the row above.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 20%; top: 0; width: 60%; height: @calc(100 - 84 * @y / @Y)%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
